acceptanceCriteria: corvint test-validity output carries the external-origin finding or UNKNOWN for runs with or without network evidence
The run receipt and the MCP test-validity profile expose the same state, with tests
body: Residual of V1-1762 (PR #1112, PWP-V0-027). The external-origin finding and its UNKNOWN state are printed only by the separate `corvint-js-test-provider external-origins` subcommand. Expected: wherever test validity is read (corvint test-validity, the run receipt, MCP test-validity profile), the environment-dependence finding or UNKNOWN appears. Actual: diagnostic-only output.
title: Join the external-origins finding and UNKNOWN into corvint test-validity, the run receipt and MCP discovery
